summary: Practise oil spill command, SCAT assessment and response planning. Review the course outline and see how it fits your operational role.
lede: Oil spill preparedness and response training prepares supervisors and incident commanders to coordinate spill operations from initial assessment through close-out. It develops practical skills in using ICS command roles, assessing spill conditions and selecting response tactics, while tracking resources and documenting decisions. Exercises include shoreline assessment with SCAT and building incident action plans, response logs and review outlines.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or support operational decisions during oil spill incidents, from initial field assessment through command coordination and incident close-out.
prerequisites: Prior operational exposure to oil spill response, terminal or offshore operations, or environmental emergency work is recommended. You should be familiar with incident reporting and basic emergency response roles. Coding is not required.
